title: Dependent-Parent Additions When Disability Compensation Past-Due Follows a Rating Decision
content:
The parent additions in a Disability Compensation decision past-due are as many parent additions as the parent maximum of 2 when the award records at least 2 dependent parents; one parent addition when it records exactly one dependent parent; and nothing when it records none.

Dependent parents recorded are the parent additions on the award less the parent removals, counted for every month a decision past-due covers. A standing month paid at the individual unemployability rate takes the 100 percent tier's parent addition of 176.88; any other standing month takes the award's own tier's parent addition.

**Boundary illustration (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating), a month at the veteran-alone rate)**

- 1 dependent parent recorded: 53.06.
- 2 dependent parents recorded: 53.06 for each, 106.12.
- 3 parent additions recorded and 1 removed: 2 recorded, 106.12.
- No dependent parent recorded: nothing.
- 2 dependent parents, a month at the individual unemployability rate: 176.88 for each, 353.76.
